The bookcase has a rectangular silhouette with visible vertical dividers creating columns and horizontal shelves. To the right, there is a chair with a cushion, a floor lamp, and a tall vase with white flowers. On the wall above the bookcase, there is a framed picture and a small potted plant on top of the unit.
